authorization.scope: Analyze SPEC-0001, SPEC-0002 and SPEC-0003 as specimens only

classification.scope: Public output authored from nonpublic prompts, discussion or drafting inputs
classification.authorization_condition: No separate permission to release the inputs

comparisons.assessment: More sharply states the same intent: authorization to publish a result does not imply authorization to expose its source context.
The concern is disclosure of the drafting context itself, not just disclosure of confidential facts.
NOM-0001 covers private source content in public repositories; broader public publication requires a separately scoped rule.
Private diaries remain private; no public release is authorized by diary storage permission.

disposition.outcome: One draft candidate created from both specimens; not automatically added to the rule catalog.

uncertainties: The distinction between private metadata, private conversation wording, and information explicitly authorized for citation needs later normative review.
